_preregistration.classes: funnel: fix>=0.30 & modal>=0.30; none: fix<=0.10; fragmented: fix>=0.30 & modal<0.20; borderline otherwise
_preregistration.stability: same class from both seeds at 96 starts; unstable = underpowered, not a class
_preregistration.dedup_pair: pythia-410m vs -deduped: same tokenizer/arch/schedule, corpus dedup only -- if dedup alone changes the class, the recipe correlate dies here
_preregistration.recipe_labels: hand-entered from model cards; documentation, not measurement; reported descriptively, no test at this n

verdict: STABILITY: 17/17 models keep their class across two census seeds at 96 starts. The taxonomy is a stable property of each map at this resolution. DEDUP CONFOUND: pythia-410m and -deduped are the SAME class (funnel) -- corpus deduplication alone does not change the map's class, so the recipe correlate survives its cheapest confound. RECIPE ASSOCIATION (descriptive, documentation-derived labels, no test at this n): from-scratch/funnel: 8; from-scratch/none: 4; modified/borderline: 1; modified/fragmented: 1; modified/none: 2; other/fragmented: 1.

_analysis_provenance.note: sha256 of the analysis source at write time, plus the repo-local import closure. If any of these does not match the file on disk, the analysis was produced by a different version of the code -- re-run it before reading the numbers (issue #38; the imports half closes the same hole one level down the import graph). Third-party package versions are NOT covered.

_note: Hardens F87's funnel/none/fragmented taxonomy: 96 starts (4x the band census), two independent census seeds, class rule registered before the data, stability required before a class is claimed. The duped/deduped pythia-410m pair isolates the cheapest confound of the recipe correlate (corpus dedup alone, same tokenizer/arch/schedule). Recipe labels are hand-entered from model cards and are documentation, not measurement; the association is reported descriptively with no test at this n.
